integrity: The infinite theorem is proved symbolically. The included finite script is only a sanity check. Primary-source premises for regularity and fineness were inspected in the 2026 and 2016 papers, respectively.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to nonzero rank-one von Neumann regular matrices in M_2(Z). It does not classify higher-dimensional or invertible regular matrices. A 2006 paper on second-order integral similarity was bibliographically inspected but its full text was not available in the accessible source, leaving a residual risk that the bare residue normal form is known there; the fine-locus coupling necessarily uses later fine-ring results.
title: Trace strata of rank-one regular integral matrices
